    adv_gap_raw = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l).detach()

    delta_clamped = ops.clamp(delta, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(delta_clamped))
    loss = ops.mul(loss, norm_factor)

    mid = n // 2
    if n % 2 == 1:

    norm_factor = 1.0 / (median_abs + eps)

    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    loss = ops.mul(loss, norm_factor)

    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']

    cost_b = batch['cost_b']
    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']

    gap_cost = ops.sub(cost_b, cost_a).detach()
    adv_gap_raw = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l).detach()
    adv_gap_tanh = ops.tanh(adv_gap_raw)

    # Median Absolute Deviation calculation
    median_val = ops.median(adv_gap_raw)
    mad = ops.median(ops.abs(ops.sub(adv_gap_raw, median_val)))

    adv_gap_std_raw = ops.std(adv_gap_raw)
    adaptive_std = ops.clamp(adv_gap_std_raw, 0.05, 0.5)
    adaptive_mad = ops.clamp(mad, 0.03, 0.4)

    margin_clamp_mult = ops.add(1.0, ops.mul(adaptive_mad, 3.0))

        ops.mul(margin_scale, adv_gap_tanh),
        ops.neg(ops.mul(adaptive_std, margin_clamp_mult)),
        ops.mul(adaptive_std, margin_clamp_mult)
    )

            margin
        ),
        ops.add(ops.mul(-0.1, gap_cost), bias_term)
    )

    delta_clamped = ops.clamp(delta, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(delta_clamped))
